historical_record.description: The Recreation Commission engaged William G. Merchant, architect, for the building plans of the A. J. Rossi recreation center project, on an estimated cost of $325,000.

For lack of bond money for both pool and building, the Recreation and Park Commission awarded a contract for the Angelo J. Rossi swimming pool alone, at Arguello and Anza Streets, to Martinelli Construction Co. at $409,000.
